description:
About DevRev 

 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

 About the team 

 The Applied AI Engineering team ensures our customers get the optimal experience from DevRev. As customers go through their DevRev journey, they may identify needs for integration with existing enterprise systems and services, workflow and process automation, or customization of the DevRev platform to achieve their business objectives. Our team works with customers to understand requirements and design, develop, and implement solutions to meet customer goals.

 Your mission is to systematically help customers find value with DevRev by developing a thorough understanding of their needs, owning coordination between internal and external stakeholders, and engineering the solution to get the job done. You are a product expert and will use your application development and AI/ML skills to ensure our customers get the most out of the DevRev platform.

  

 About the role 

 As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our post-sales Customer Experience team to help customers unlock value through AI. You will design and deploy intelligent agents, automated workflows, and integrations that transform how customers operate — connecting DevRev to their broader ecosystem and putting AI to work across their most important business processes. Where needed, you will build custom applications and solutions in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and related languages to bring these experiences to life.

 You will employ your creativity and technical expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics, and workflows are used in customers’ processes. You are a product expert focused on implementation — building, shipping, and iterating to ensure customers get the most out of the DevRev platform.

  

 What You’ll Do 

 
 Customer-Facing: 30% working directly with customers

 Coding & Integration: 70–80% hands-on technical implementation

 
 Build & Deploy 

 
 Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations connecting DevRev with customer environments

 Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow

 Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience

 
 Data & Insights 

 
 Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making

 Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback

 
 Collaboration & Enablement 

 
 Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, and customer success teams

 Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows

 Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements

 
  

 What You Bring 

 
 Experience: 3–5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus

 Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms.

 Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling; ability to build and configure AI agents

 Integration: Deep experience with API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), large-scale data synchronization, and event-driven/pub-sub architectures

 Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices

 Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems

 Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging

 Communication: Strong written and verbal skills; ability to engage customers clearly and confidently

 Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline

 DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.
